features: Analog Turbo HD ColorVu pan-tilt turret — 1 HD analog output over coax; NOT an IP camera
Smart-Hybrid light: up to 20 m white light and 25 m IR
Built-in mic and speaker with two-way audio over coaxial cable
Active strobe (red/blue flashing) light and audible alarm deterrence
release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2CE70DF0T-PTLXTS is an analog Turbo HD 2MP ColorVu pan-tilt turret with 24/7 full-color imaging (F1.0), Smart-Hybrid light (20 m white / 25 m IR), two-way audio over coax and active strobe/siren deterrence. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet (DS-2CE70DF0T-PTLXTS_Datasheet_20260115.pdf).
